sources.notes: SOURCE: Redigo.info — Verbale integrativo sottoscritto il 25 novembre 2024 (accordo siglato 18 novembre 2024). Salary tables for aziende artigiane (Art. 33): 8 tranches starting Dec 2024. All 8 level values confirmed. Level 1A total includes indennita di funzione 51.65 EUR.

SOURCE: Kitech.it — CNEL code G016 confirmed. Mar 2026 salary table cross-validated: 1A base 2490.07 + indennita funzione 51.65 = 2541.72 total. Hourly divisor 173 confirmed. Seniority amounts per level confirmed: 1A=16.01, 1B=16.01, 2=14.20, 3=13.43, 4=12.65, 5bis=11.88, 5=11.36, 6=10.33. Cadence 24m, max 5 scatti.

SOURCE: Lavoro-Economia.it — Aggregator showing CCNL text. Per-level seniority amounts independently match kitech.it: 1A=16.01, 1B=16.01, 2=14.20, 3=13.43, 4=12.65, 5bis=11.88, 5=11.36, 6=10.33. Hourly divisor 173 confirmed (40h/week table). Page reflects pre-2024 CCNL base text; amounts not changed by 2024 rinnovo. NOTE: aggregator source, not verified against CCNL PDF.

SOURCE: ADAPT Farecontrattazione.it — Academic analysis of the Nov 2024 rinnovo. Confirms: aziende artigiane total increase EUR 200 over 4 tranches (Dec 2024, Jul 2025, Mar 2026, Nov 2026). Apprenticeship new rules: operai/tecnici 5 years max, amministrativi 3 years, centraliniste 2 years. Apprentice seniority accrual improved in rinnovo. CNEL G016, INPS ARTIGIANATO sector.

notes: INFO: SALARY MODEL: conglobated (minimi tabellari conglobati). Confirmed: ilccnl.it shows contingenza=0.00 for all levels. Back-calculation at Jul 2025: livello 4=1763.56/173=10.194 EUR/h, livello 1B=2160.15/173=12.487 EUR/h, livello 6=1452.42/173=8.394 EUR/h — all values divide to proportional hourly rates consistent with divisor 173, confirming conglobated model.
INFO: CNEL CODE: G016 confirmed from kitech.it and ADAPT farecontrattazione.it.
INFO: TRANCHE DATES: four tranches — 2024-12-01 (from Nov 2024 verbale integrativo), 2025-07-01, 2026-03-01, 2026-11-01. Source: redigo.info. Cross-validated Mar 2026 values against kitech.it.
INFO: HOURLY DIVISOR: 173. Source: ilccnl.it explicit '173.00 ore'. Cross-validated via back-calculation across 3 levels (see conglobated check above).
INFO: ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima only). Source: ilccnl.it ('una mensilita globale di fatto'). No quattordicesima.

INFO: SENIORITY: biennale (every 24 months), maximum 5 scatti. Per-level EUR amounts from two independent aggregators (kitech.it, lavoro-economia.it): 1A=16.01, 1B=16.01, 2=14.20, 3=13.43, 4=12.65, 5bis=11.88, 5=11.36, 6=10.33. Cadence confirmed '5 aumenti biennali' from lavoro-economia.it. SIMPLIFICATION: primary source (CCNL PDF or official signatory site) not fetched; amounts not disputed by the 2024 rinnovo analysis (informaimpresa.it mentions only the NEW EUR 10 apprentice scatto, not a change to permanent scatti).

INFO: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: EUR 10.00 from 2025-01-01. New clause introduced by Nov 2024 rinnovo ('Migliorata la norma relativa agli apprendisti che andranno a maturare gli scatti di anzianita'). Amount EUR 10.00 from CNA Ancona official communication. Zero before Jan 2025.

INFO: LEVEL 1A FUNCTION ALLOWANCE: indennita di funzione EUR 51.65, confirmed kitech.it Mar 2026 (base 2490.07 + allowance 51.65 = total 2541.72). Assumed constant from Dec 2024; no primary source shows a change in this amount through the 2024 rinnovo.

INFO: LEVEL ORDERING: 6 (lowest) < 5 < 5bis < 4 < 3 < 2 < 1B < 1A (highest). Level 5bis has higher salary than level 5 — this is correct per the CCNL (5bis = specializzato BIS, above the basic specializzato).

INFO: APPRENTICESHIP: new rules from 2024-11-18 rinnovo for post-Nov-18-2024 contracts. Track durations confirmed from adapt.it (G016-specific): operai/tecnici max 5 years, amministrativi max 3 years, centraliniste 2 years. Percentage progressions (70/78/85/92/100% for operai/tecnici; 70/80/90% for amministrativi) follow the Confartigianato/CNA artigianato national framework agreement (CCNA); G016-specific source (adapt.it) confirms durations but not the individual percentages. SIMPLIFICATION: percentages assumed from artigianato CCNA framework; not found in a G016-specific primary source (CCNL PDF not fetched).

SIMPLIFICATION: Only aziende artigiane salary tables modelled. PMI non-artigiane tables (Art. 4, with EUR 207 total increase vs EUR 200 for artigiane, difference of EUR 7 in the Nov 2026 tranche) are not modelled. Applies to a small minority of firms covered by this CCNL.

SIMPLIFICATION: Only post-Nov-18-2024 apprenticeship rules modelled. Pre-renewal CCNL used a semestrali hybrid model (old percentage tables). Firms with apprenticeship contracts signed before Nov 18, 2024 may still follow the previgente rules.

SIMPLIFICATION: Centraliniste (switchboard operators) have a 2-year apprenticeship track per the 2024 rinnovo. Modelled as the general 3-year amministrativi track (overstates duration by 1 year for that role).

SIMPLIFICATION: Both apprenticeship tracks (operai_tecnici and amministrativi) are assigned to all 8 destination levels. In practice, the CCNL differentiates by job role, not only by destination level. Firms must select the correct track by role type.
SIMPLIFICATION: LEVEL CATEGORY: all levels left null. Multiple levels map to both operai and impiegati roles — a genuine one-to-many mapping the schema cannot represent as a single category value.

SIMPLIFICATION: Level 1A indennita di funzione EUR 51.65 assumed constant across all four tranches (Dec 2024 through Nov 2026+). Kitech.it only shows the Mar 2026 value; no primary source confirms the amount in Dec 2024 or Jul 2025. Difference is likely zero (function allowances are rarely changed in salary renewals) but not verified.

levels.description: Livello 6 — lavoratore comune, addetto a mansioni di ordine
Livello 5 BIS — lavoratore specializzato (intermedio tra 5 e 4)
Livello 3 — lavoratore altamente specializzato / impiegato di concetto
Livello 2 — tecnico / impiegato di concetto superiore
Livello 1A — quadro superiore / responsabile (+ indennita di funzione 51.65 EUR)

fixed_allowances.description: Indennita di funzione (solo livello 1A). Fonte: kitech.it Mar 2026. Importo assunto costante da dic 2024.
